audit.summary: Change class: standard. 0 CRITICAL, 0 HIGH, 0 MEDIUM, 0 LOW, across correctness, security, maintainability and test-adequacy. All three round-1 findings are resolved. CR-PBI024-01 (MEDIUM): carried() (export_board.py:377-396) parses, marks and re-serialises inside one try that catches (ValueError, RecursionError), and returns the raw bytes with a warning. The new test covers 200000-deep nesting and the U+D800 escape with exit 0, the bytes unchanged and the healthy project still exported. CR-PBI024-02 (LOW): the +01:00 to Z conversion and the set-clear-set-again lifecycle now each have a test. CR-PBI024-03 (LOW): tab_bytes() (export_board.py:371-374) is now the only indent=1 serialisation, used by carried() and by main()'s write loop (export_board.py:444-445), and test_kept_tabs_are_byte_identical asserts the exact first-carry bytes. No regression from binary-mode writing: all 6 rebuilt tabs from origin/main's exporter and the new one are byte-identical (4 hold non-ASCII bytes, none holds CR), and 5 stress documents give identical bytes both ways. Those cover U+2028/U+2029, U+0085, an astral character, CR/LF in strings, control characters, floats, NaN, big ints, empty containers and an empty dict. So no tab is pushed again because of the format. Warning: it fires once per unreadable kept file on each run (run 1 and run 2 each named each corrupt file once), never for a readable marked file (4 marked files, no warning), and it prints only the path and an exception type name, so the planted SECRET content did not appear on stderr. Run 2 left every kept file byte for byte as run 1 wrote it. AC-alignment: AC-125, stable while carried, clears on recovery, scope, docs, out of scope and the local conformance test are met. The close-out criterion cannot be verified until the change is committed (see not_audited). Verdict GO. Flag-only: nothing was changed, staged, committed, pushed or deployed, and refresh.py was not run.
